messages.author: 2b17849511e2f19e
messages.subject: Error with cluster setup
parts:
Hello. I am trying to use g.shell function and I am getting this error. I am using a mac 10.15.4 


Error in makePSOCKcluster(names = spec, ...) :
  Cluster setup failed. 7 of 7 workers failed to connect.

messages.author: 13568954e9b4ef4b
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Error with cluster setup
parts:
Looks like an issue with the parallel or foreach packages.

Can you try to run the examples in the foreach package: https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/foreach/foreach.pdf If you get the same error there then you know that it is an issue specific to those packages.

If that does not address it, try setting a lower chunksize, e.g. chunksize = 0.3 or setting argument do.parallel = TRUE, just to see whether it is an issue with memory space.

Vincent

parts:
thanks Vincent. I have tried the foreach package's example. 

install.packages("foreach", dependencies = T)
library(foreach)

# equivalent to rnorm(3)
times(3) %do% rnorm(1)
# equivalent to lapply(1:3, sqrt)
foreach(i=1:3) %do%
  sqrt(i)
# multiple ... arguments
foreach(i=1:4, j=1:10) %do%
  sqrt(i+j)
# equivalent to colMeans(m)
foreach-ext 5
m <- matrix(rnorm(9), 3, 3)
foreach(i=1:ncol(m), .combine=c) %do%
  mean(m[,i])
# normalize the rows of a matrix in parallel, with parenthesis used to
# force proper operator precedence
# Need to register a parallel backend before this example will run
# in parallel
foreach(i=1:nrow(m), .combine=rbind) %dopar%
  (m[i,] / mean(m[i,]))
# simple (and inefficient) parallel matrix multiply
library(iterators)
a <- matrix(1:16, 4, 4)
b <- t(a)
foreach(b=iter(b, by='col'), .combine=cbind) %dopar%
  (a %*% b)
# split a data frame by row, and put them back together again without
# changing anything
d <- data.frame(x=1:10, y=rnorm(10))
s <- foreach(d=iter(d, by='row'), .combine=rbind) %dopar% d
identical(s, d)
# a quick sort function
qsort <- function(x) {
  n <- length(x)
  if (n == 0) {
    x
  } else {
    p <- sample(n, 1)
    smaller <- foreach(y=x[-p], .combine=c) %:% when(y <= x[p]) %do% y
    larger <- foreach(y=x[-p], .combine=c) %:% when(y > x[p]) %do% y
    c(qsort(smaller), x[p], qsort(larger))
  }
}
qsort(runif(12))


and then I tried this. 


g.shell.GGIR(mode=1:5,datadir=c("*****")
             
             
             ,outputdir=c("*****"),do.parallel = T, chunksize = 0.3)

and I  am still getting the same error message.

Error in makePSOCKcluster(names = spec, ...) :
  Cluster setup failed. 7 of 7 workers failed to connect.

I found this tweet talking about a problem with r 4.0.1 having a problem with memory allocation(https://twitter.com/pdalgd/status/1270472438812377088?s=20 ) I looked for version 4.0.0 but I can't find it anywhere. My version is 4.0.1

If that does not address it, try setting a lower chunksize, e.g. chunksize = 0.3 or setting argument do.parallel = TRUE, just to see whether it is an issue with memory space.
